caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass goblet positioned upright and centered on a plain, light beige background. The goblet has a slightly flared rim, a smooth, gradually curving bowl, a thin stem, and a round, flat base. The glass is shaded with light blue and green tones, giving the appearance of reflections and translucency characteristic of clear glass. There are no other objects or decorative elements present, and the background is entirely unornamented except for a small handwritten signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Wine Glass
